title: X3Native Fleet Status
description: Periodically-regenerated JSON consumed by the Element sidebar widget. Shows per-machine presence + branch state + integrator queue.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this snapshot was produced. Widget displays as 'updated 2 min ago'.

machines.description: One entry per fleet PC. Order is the widget's display order.

name.description: Canonical machine slug (lowercase). Matches the Matrix bot account suffix.

lan_ip.description: LAN IPv4. Source of truth is ~/.claude/.fleet_hosts.json on the generator machine.

presence.description: Aggregated from presence_source. online=ping reachable + matrix-daemon connected within 10 min. away=ping reachable but no matrix presence in 10-60 min. dormant=ping fail OR no matrix presence in 60+ min. unknown=ping fail + no presence ever seen.

presence_source.description: Which signal(s) we used to derive presence.

last_seen_at.description: Most recent presence-ping receipt from this machine's matrix-daemon.

last_seen_ago_sec.description: Convenience field for the widget. Same value as generated_at - last_seen_at.

branches.description: Branches currently associated with this machine (refs/remotes/origin/feat/*-machine OR by integrator dispatch in main).

head_sha.description: Short or full commit SHA at branch HEAD.

head_subject.description: Subject line of the HEAD commit (first line of the commit message).

head_committed_at.description: When the HEAD commit was created.

ahead_of_main.description: Number of commits the branch is ahead of origin/main.

behind_main.description: Number of commits the branch is behind origin/main. >0 means the branch needs a rebase before it can be merged cleanly.

ready_for_integration.description: True iff the branch's STATUS block in its associated <MACHINE>.md says 'READY FOR INTEGRATION' (textual match, simple).

role.description: Fleet role per the spec. 13700K=integrator, 14900K=showcase, the laptop OG=primary, the others=worker.

notes.description: Free-text notes the integrator can pin (e.g. 'I4400 just upgraded to Win11 — verify daemon survives reboot').

integration_queue.description: Branches awaiting the integrator's merge. Ordered by age (oldest first).

status_blurb.description: First sentence of the branch's STATUS block.

warnings.description: Anything the widget should highlight at the top — stale daemons, branches behind main, etc.
